summary: Iteration 4 — Dual-price (price_kg / price_piece) feature verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_dual_price.py (POST/PUT with both prices default sell_unit=kg, POST/PUT without any price → 422, POST with only price_piece → sell_unit=piece + price_kg=null, POST with only price_kg → sell_unit=kg + price_piece=null, GET /products exposes both fields on all seeded products, Pommes Gala has price_kg=2.58 & price_piece=0.35). Frontend admin: /product-edit shows two side-by-side inputs (testID edit-price-kg / edit-price-piece), old 'Vendu au' sell_unit chip is gone, editing Pommes Gala prefills 2.58 and 0.35, saving returns to catalog with 'Produit mis à jour' toast. Frontend client: on Pommes Gala both 'Au kilo' and 'À la pièce' chips are active-selectable (each shows its own price 2.58 € / 0.35 €), tapping switches selection and updates the main price + CTA + subtotal (qty=3 → 3 × 0.35 = 1.05 €), no 'uniquement' toast when both prices exist, Ajouter au panier adds the correct line and shows 'Pommes Gala : 3 pce ajouté(s)' with cart badge = 1. For Basilic frais (piece-only): kg chip is greyed with '—', tapping it displays 'Ce produit est vendu à la pièce uniquement' toast and does not change the selection. RN deprecation noted (already reported in iter 3): props.pointerEvents on ToastProvider Animated.View.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/toast.tsx:38 (pre-existing, non-blocking)

action_items: Optional: move pointerEvents='none' from the prop to the style object in ToastProvider (src/toast.tsx:38) to silence the RN deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductIn.resolved() correctly enforces 'at least one price' with a 422 HTTPException and derives sell_unit deterministically (kg wins when both provided).

Startup migration in server.py populates price_kg/price_piece for legacy products from (price, sell_unit) — verified via GET /products (all 15 seeded products expose both fields with at least one non-null).
product-detail.tsx correctly wires selectedUnit off availableUnits(product) and priceFor(product, unit), so the main price / subtotal / CTA all reflect the selected unit live.
product-edit.tsx replaces the single Vendu au + price with two clean side-by-side inputs, correctly using undefined (not 0) when a price is empty so the backend receives null and passes the 422 rule.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin edit + client product-detail flows for both dual-price and single-price products)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used existing seeded products (Pommes Gala = dual price, Basilic frais = piece-only). Test-created products in dual-price tests are all cleaned up via DELETE at the end of each case.

rca_of_issue: Not a bug fix — feature verification. Backend ProductIn.resolved() enforces the 'at least one price' rule and derives sell_unit; product-edit renders two independent numeric inputs; product-detail computes availableUnits(product) → chip.available; when both prices are set both chips are available (no greyed state), when one is missing the other chip is greyed with '—' and taps trigger a toast.
